news.contents: Chicago Bears running back Kyle Monangai (toe, thumb) was a full participant in practice for the second straight day on Thursday, according to ESPN's Courtney Cronin. Monangai said on Sunday that he is "on track" to return for the Week 11 contest on Sunday against the visiting New Orleans Saints, and he looks well on his way to playing for the first time since Week 4 due to turf-toe and right-thumb injuries. news.contents: Minnesota Vikings wide receiver Justin Jefferson put together one of his better performances of the season last week. Both the targets and receptions were season highs for Jefferson, who has struggled to make an impact this season.
